text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka invites me to watch a so-called hard-boiled movie at the theater.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the movie is over…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… sob…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh… That was so good! It's a damn masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The main character and his best friend fought their way to the top of the school—literally!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And then when he went one-on-one with the top of the rival school and they ended up becoming friends… Wow!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I guess the best friends are the ones who push you to fight with all you've got.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I know my fiercest rival is the one I consider my clos… est…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: B-but I uh, not all my rivals are cool though! One of them's really annoying!
choice_data_list: (This… is about Daiwa Scarlet, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, enough about that! What I'm tryin' to say is…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Don't ya think we should have a one-on-one battle too?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Am I wrong? Umamusume and their trainers have to understand each other on a deep level, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And there are some things you can only communicate with your fists! So let's do this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seems like that movie gave Vodka some… interesting ideas. I understand what she's trying to say, but it's not like we can actually fight each other…
choice_data_list: How about we fight with our legs instead—a race.
How about we fight with our legs instead—a race.
Then let's duke it out, heart-to-heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seems like that movie gave Vodka some… interesting ideas. I understand what she's trying to say, but it's not like we can actually fight each other…
choice_data_list: How about we fight with our legs instead—a race.
How about we fight with our legs instead—a race.
Then let's duke it out, heart-to-heart!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? A race?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Don't make me laugh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You? Challenge me? Are you out of your mind?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but you've got zero chan—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Aaaughhh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: H-hold on… What I just said…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's exactly what the guy in the movie said right before he got his butt kicked!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You know, the thug who took one look at the main character and totally dropped his guard!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: If the same thing's happening here… Don't tell me you're actually super fast?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Hah! A-all right. I guess you're on then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But not today! If you really wanna do this, you're gonna have to wait!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Don't get the wrong idea! I'm not backin' out or anything!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I just mean, I just think we've had our fill of battle today after that movie… right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So yeah, our fight's on hold for now! Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And then I'll do some training! Just in case!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like I've avoided the challenge for the time being. Secretly relieved, I join Vodka for her training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Uhhh… What does that even mean?
choice_data_list: …Like, we could hit each other with our best compliments?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: C-com…pliments? No way! What's the point? …And besides, that's not even a fight!
choice_data_list: You're right. Forget I mentioned it…
You're right. Forget I mentioned it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I just blurted out the first thing that came to mind, so I try to change the subject. But…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …But I guess, you're on. I'm tough enough to take a few.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I-I mean if you need to get 'em outta your system, go ahead and fire away.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'll be fine. A real bud isn't afraid to take a fall for a friend. So hit me with your best shot!
choice_data_list: Okay… I'll give it a try then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! C-come at me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so I list out all the good things I've noticed about Vodka since I met her, until…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Okay! Okay, okay, okay, okay! That's enough, already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After compliment number fifty or so, she suddenly stops me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: C'mon, how many do you have?! This is so embarrassin', you're gonna make me pass out!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aughhh! I said knock it off, already!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Geez. How many even was that? You're wack…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What?! I have to do it too?!
choice_data_list: It's a one-on-one fight, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gulp!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Fine. It's not like me to just take a beating! Give me a sec, I'll take ya down in one blow!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The thing about… you… is…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You're… really nice!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaah! You're supposed to be embarrassed, dummy!
